description:
Molecular Evolutionary Genetics Analysis

Genome sequencing is generating vast amounts of DNA sequence data from a wide range of organisms. As a result, gene sequence databases are growing rapidly. In order to conduct efficient analyses of these data, there is a need for easy-to-use computer programs, containing fast computational algorithms and useful statistical methods. The objective of the MEGA software has been to provide tools for exploring, discovering, and analyzing DNA and protein sequences from an evolutionary perspective.
Bug Fixes
- Name and divergence time searches using the Timetree resource have been updated to use the new Timetree API URLs.
- Distance calculations using the Pamilo-Bianchi-Li and Li-Wu-Luo methods for dN and dS estimation on Windows operating systems have been fixed.
- Scale bar positioning for trees displayed in the radial style has been updated to avoid overlapping with taxa names.
- Missing citation for MEGA 12.1 on Linux operating systems has been fixed.
